inference_table_tracing.purpose: Platform teams can investigate historical LLM queries, token usage, latency, and safety filter triggers

governed_gateway_routing.description: All LLM traffic from the app routes through sentinel-governed-gateway instead of calling Foundation Model endpoints directly
governed_gateway_routing.extends_to: MCP calls and coding-agent traffic can be routed through the same gateway by configuring their base_url to the gateway endpoint
governed_gateway_routing.architecture: App → sentinel-governed-gateway (AI Gateway) → databricks-claude-sonnet-5 (Foundation Model API)
